title: 3.3.19 Lab: Write a Function That Returns a New Array
description: Write a function that builds and returns a new array of transformed values (for example, each number doubled with result.push(n * 2), as in 3.3.15), proving the original is untouched. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Write a function with an array parameter
steps.instructions: Write a function declaration called doubled that takes an array parameter (the numbers to double).

steps.title: Build a new array inside it
steps.instructions: Create a new empty array inside the function and use a for...of loop to push each number, doubled (n * 2), into it, as in 3.3.15.

steps.title: Return the new array
steps.instructions: After the loop, return the new array. Do not change the array you were given.

steps.title: Call it and log both arrays
steps.instructions: Call doubled with a sample array and console.log both the result and the original array to show the original is untouched.

requirements.title: function with an array parameter that is not mutated
requirements.description: Code declares a function whose array parameter is never changed inside it (no push, pop, shift, unshift, splice, sort, reverse, fill or index assignment on it). Help: 3.3.15 (Arrays and Functions)

requirements.title: for loop present
requirements.description: Code uses a for or for...of loop. Help: 3.3.5 (Looping Over Arrays (for / for…of))

requirements.title: function returns the new array
requirements.description: A return inside the function hands back the new array. Help: 3.3.15 (Arrays and Functions)

requirements.title: the new array differs from the input
requirements.description: A pushed value is changed (arithmetic or a call) or only pushed when an if says so, so the result is not a plain copy. Help: 3.3.15 (Arrays and Functions)

requirements.title: both arrays are logged
requirements.description: console.log is called at least twice: once for the returned array and once for the original. Help: 3.3.15 (Arrays and Functions)

requirements.title: doubled returns a new, doubled array and leaves the original alone
requirements.description: doubled(numbers) returns a NEW array holding every number doubled, in the same order, and the array you pass in is not changed. Help: 3.3.15 (Arrays and Functions)
requirements.hint: Build a separate result array, push n * 2 for every number, and return the result. Pushing onto or assigning into the array you were given changes the original.
